_status: SUPPORT FILE for figures/journal_v3/make_fig06_module.R. POST-HOC and DESCRIPTIVE, inheriting DA62. No new inference: this re-reads committed files, aggregates, and runs the same Fisher/BH enrichment the committed runs use.
_arm_definition: s1 is the sign of the TF-expression-to-target-gene correlation. '+' arms are activating, '-' arms repressing. Pooling different TFs' arms of the same sign is legitimate; merging one TF's own two arms is not, and is not done here (see analysis/F6_NETWORK_ANALYSIS.md CORRECTION 2026-08-31).

mixture_and_activity._denominator_note: Three different counts are easy to confuse. The Stage-3 pseudobulk the decomposition reads carries 19 cell types. The module's own activity profile lists 16. Six are admitted. The honest denominator for 'how much of the hierarchy is the composition term blind to' is 19, the set the decomposition could in principle have used. A figure of 20 has circulated and matches no committed file.
mixture_and_activity._note: reweighting_only_effect freezes activity at Diagnosis and applies the Relapse mixture, so it isolates the mixture with no regulatory change. It is computed on cell-type means POOLED ACROSS PATIENTS, so it is not identical in construction to the per-patient decomposition in f6_decomposition.json and is not a substitute for it; it establishes the RELATIVE SIZE of the mixture effect only.

arm_enrichment.background: union of all 201 pool regulons' targets, intersected with the expressed universe
arm_enrichment.background_saturation_note: the expressed-universe background saturates -- 44 of 50 Hallmark terms significant -- so it is not used and no term from it is quoted
arm_enrichment.bh_family: library x vocabulary x arm x gene set
